BM25 filter keeps only pages relevant to the query

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'bm25_query' => 'rust programming language', 'bm25_threshold' => 0.1, 'content_filter' => 'bm25', 'max_depth' => 1 }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.crawl(engine, url)
puts result.pages[0].html.inspect
```
